## How this work is cited

Passages inside Self-Reliance are identified by essay — no internal divisions. An essay rather than a book, and one of the most quoted in American letters. It has no numbered sections, so the archive cites the essay and quotes the sentence.

## The work in Ralph Waldo Emerson’s thought

Ralph Waldo Emerson (1803–1882) was the American Transcendentalist essayist and lecturer who urged self-reliance and unbroken relation to nature and the Over-Soul. A former Unitarian minister in Concord, he gathered the Dial circle and mentored younger writers including Thoreau. [More on Ralph Waldo Emerson](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/ralph-waldo-emerson) .
